chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ziyad, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I guarantee that one who leaves his house wearing a turban will return to his family safe and sound.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of leaving the house wearing a turban according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) guarantees safety for one who departs wearing a turban, reflecting the pre-Islamic and early Islamic cultural significance of the turban as a symbol of dignity, honor, and readiness for travel. This practice was not merely aesthetic but carried spiritual weight, serving as a physical manifestation of modesty and social standing that invoked divine protection during journeys.
